user_go: freeze GO given 2026-08-07 (chat: '继续' after B clarification)

bank.lag_cap_note: 7 basins calibrate lag_time>10 (max 14.99); routing memory holds 10 slots; truth and filters use the SAME capped value (internally consistent, flagged in outputs)

truth.generator: hbv_joint_uncertainty.hbv_adapter.advance_state 15-state stepwise; routing buffer init zeros; stage-1 (180d) is burn-in before first evaluated switch
truth.slz_noise: multiplicative lognormal, SLZ *= exp(N(-sigma^2/2, sigma)), sigma=0.02, applied after each daily step; discharge routed from post-step memory (unaffected same-day)
truth.truth_seed_stream: SeedSequence((20260807, int(basin_id), k)) for k in 0..1
truth.sigma_obs_rule: max(0.10 * median(finite real obs in window), 0.02) mm/day, per basin, from G1 CSV

filter.initial_state: calibration-final 5 hydro states + zero routing buffer, same as truth init
filter.observation_operator: rising-half routed discharge (weights ascending with age), capped lag
filter.interaction: parameter_grouped (id23 legacy default; distinct groups 0,1,2 => no cross-parameter state mixing)

event_rule.run_must_fit_in_window: start day <= switch+25 so the 5-day run ends within the 30-day window

transfer_gate.criterion: pass rate among predicted-identifiable >= 0.80 AND one-sided two-proportion z-test vs predicted-fail group p < 0.05

deviations_from_id23: no per-panel visual gate (scale); 5-basin stratified blind visual audit, descriptive only
footprints in G1 computed with simulate_hbv_lite full-series; truth in G2 generated with advance_state stepwise (same equations, eps-projection differences immaterial; equivalence asserted in smoke)
